name: Unbeliever
overview: Scripture reveals that unbelief results in spiritual blindness and separation from God, as those who reject faith in Christ are already condemned (John 3:18; Ephesians 4:18). The unbeliever is portrayed as one alienated from the life of God and subject to judgment (Luke 12:46). Unbelief not only hinders the work of God but also leads to broken fellowship, as seen in the warning against being highminded due to unbelief (Romans 11:20; Matthew 13:58). The topic encompasses relationships with unbelievers, including dating, marrying, and friendship, highlighting the spiritual risks involved.
